task: Academic PDF Metadata Extraction Reliability and Accuracy Enhancement
user_intent: Ensure accurate, reliable metadata extraction from real-world academic papers (e.g. MDPI, IEEE, Springer) uploaded to CMS-V2 archive.
root_causes_identified: Socket.IO payload contract mismatch: BullMQ extraction worker emitted { jobId, payload: extractionPayload } while ExistingCapstoneUploadPage.jsx listened for data.data and normalizeExtractionPayload checked envelope.data, resolving undefined and causing UI to drop all extracted metadata and fall back to filename keyword scraping.
PaddleOCR-VL microservice artificial 2.5s timeout clamp: Math.min(2500, this.timeoutMs) caused multi-page PDFs to always abort and enter a 60s cooldown.
Heuristic title truncation: findTitleFromLines candidateLines was sliced to Math.min(abstractIndex, 10), cutting off papers with editorial sidebars where the title is at lines 15-25.
Editorial line leakage into title: Lines like 'Academic Editor: ...' were selected as title because skipPatterns lacked academic editor / licensee / copyright / citation patterns.

Author digit rejection: isLikelyAuthorName rejected any string with digits, causing all authors with affiliation superscripts (e.g. 'Zihao Sun 1, Peng Guo 2') to be rejected because sanitizeAuthorName did not strip trailing numbers.
Title joining bug: Continuation logic joined lines < 40 chars blindly, merging the author line into the title, corrupting both title and author detection.
Publication Year date regex flaw: extractPublicationYear failed on 'Published: 21 July 2025' or '© 2025' due to rigid keywords-to-year patterns.
Missing heuristic publication venue: publicationVenue was unextracted in heuristics and 100% dependent on external CrossRef DOI network requests.

Single-line keyword truncation: extractKeywords [^
]{3,400} dropped keywords that wrapped across lines.
solutions_implemented: server/jobs/documentExtraction.job.js: Emitted both data: extractionPayload and payload: extractionPayload on ocr:complete.
client/src/pages/archive/ExistingCapstoneUploadPage.jsx: Made normalizeExtractionPayload and onComplete defensively resolve data from payload or data or envelope root.
server/services/ocrExtraction.service.js: Set effectiveTimeout to Math.max(10000, Number(this.timeoutMs) || 15000), eliminating artificial 2.5s aborts.

server/utils/pdfMetadataExtractor.js: Expanded candidateLines to Math.min(abstractIndex, 60), added Pass 0 article-anchor ('Article', 'Research Article'), added comprehensive skipPatterns, updated sanitizeAuthorName to strip footnote digits/symbols, updated isLikelyAuthorName with publishing noise filters, added extractPublicationVenue with known venue mappings and citation patterns, updated extractPublicationYear with date/month regexes, and made extractKeywords multiline-aware.

verification.client_archive_tests: npm test --workspace=client -- src/pages/archive/ (18/18 passed including Socket.IO real-time delivery)
verification.route_parity: npm run check:endpoints (209 server, 190 client, 0 unmatched)
